articles.title: MVA Stages Jan Akrosh Morcha In Uran With Bullock Cart & Bhakri Protest Against Soaring Inflation & Fuel Prices
articles.titleEn: MVA Stages Jan Akrosh Morcha In Uran With Bullock Cart & Bhakri Protest Against Soaring Inflation & Fuel Prices
articles.summary: Mahavikas Aghadi organized a Jan Akrosh Morcha in Uran to protest rising prices of petrol, diesel, LPG, CNG, milk, and essential commodities. Led by former MLA Manohar Bhoir, participants marched with a bullock cart displaying placards, while women staged a symbolic bhakri-making protest.

articles.title: RBI worries higher energy costs could fuel inflation, slow growth
articles.titleEn: RBI worries higher energy costs could fuel inflation, slow growth
articles.summary: RBI MPC Meeting 2026 Crude Oil Price Impact on Inflation: India's headline inflation may rise by 36 basis points due to higher petrol and diesel prices. The Reserve Bank of India warns that elevated energy costs and supply disruptions will impact economic activity. Global factors are also contributing to broader inflationary pressures. The central bank has maintained its key repo rate and policy stance.

articles.title: RBI flags inflation risks, revises CPI outlook for FY27 upwards to 5.1%
articles.titleEn: RBI flags inflation risks, revises CPI outlook for FY27 upwards to 5.1%
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has raised its inflation forecast to 5.1% due to rising energy prices and an uncertain food outlook. Governor Sanjay Malhotra warned that higher input costs could further pressure CPI inflation. Petrol and diesel price hikes are expected to directly impact headline inflation in the coming months.
